title: Certify coordinated and independent-pair centre-contact cost ceilings (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This source-bound paid-invoice proof closes two chart-retagging grammars left open by [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867). The first covers coordinated changes: every subset of all 184 newly variable retained 640 centre contacts may choose its old chart or its image under one common nonzero transvection axis, simultaneously across nine different original-chart groups. It is a supporting ceiling, with no new κ or physical supplier claim.

The actual graph has 176 empty-chart contacts, eight distinct singleton original-chart groups, 256 internal rank-zero edges and eight rank-eight edges. Every rank-eight edge has a singleton endpoint of internal degree one. Exact conditional leaf elimination removes potentially negative binary interactions, leaving an integer s-t cut over the 176 empty-chart contacts. All 640 endpoints, native maps, operations and 408 helper targets stay fixed; all incident transitions remain paid, and no centre output receives independent credit.

The nine original charts have common intersection `{0}`, so the sweep literally covers all 262,143 nonzero ambient axes. They induce 419 complete rank-energy configurations. All 3,771 exact prefix-tariff cuts have optimum zero. Hence every candidate has `S_j = sum_r delta_r min(r,j) >= 0` for `j=1,...,9`; the written summation-by-parts argument proves nonnegative paid-moment change for every `0<theta<1`. The rounded moment diagnostic is not a premise of that proof. Strict loss and uniqueness are not claimed for this common-axis theorem.

The full old paid profile is `{1:2201,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:8}`, with fixed helper targets `{4:28,7:7,8:47,9:326}`. The additive second theorem covers independently chosen nontrivial distance-one neighbours at BOTH endpoints of any one of the 264 actual internal edges, with strict paid loss for `0<=theta<1`. A complete 261,632-case opposite-neighbour screen yields 44 histograms through 1,831,424 exact incident-rank checks; an independent Python replay reproduces every class and count. All classes dominate `3H1+H7-H8`, giving paid loss at least two. Different-hyperplane rank-zero cases close analytically using the authenticated [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) single-contact bound and shared-edge correction. All eight rank-eight edges have a verified degree-four external inventory giving `Delta>=2+6^theta-8^theta>=2-2^theta>0`. Their nominal 8,355,872-case sweep was stopped analytically and was **not run**. Read PAIRS-ADDENDUM.md and pairs/PROOF.md for the complete domain and endpoint convention.

Larger blocks using independent/mixed axes, changed operations or changed caller demand remain outside scope. Native phase/word construction, all 640 primal/raw-dual checks, owned caller, compiler/precision and outer admission remain additional obligations; no profitable invoice exists in this grammar to justify launching them. Primary κ research continues through a different operation/budget gate.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base and refreshed main: `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7, **scope changed** from a proposed rank-shape construction to this exact finite paid-invoice ceiling. TASK.json retains the full originating card and explains the change. The concrete bounded object is the retained 640 centre contact graph with all 184 binary choices and all 262143 common axes; no seeds or random restarts are used.

- [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) at `5e4cce12a9851fbb46cd7c32cc8177e983771539` supplies the retained 640 graph, source bytes and prior single/pair/single-original-group ceiling. This adds simultaneous choices across different original groups through an exact leaf reduction.
- Nick Petalas [PR #4864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4864) at `eac6ce76eeabdd027b6cb5cbedd0e006e784bfce` supplies the general tuple/cycle-constrained neighborhood geometry. It is citation-only here, not imported, executed or re-proved. The present graph has identity internal maps and uses literal ambient-axis enumeration; its actual boundary invoice is the new application.
- David Ganz / Dugongue [PR #4841](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4841) at `6debdcdac8fe1c87958f8cd42ccb7db73c0a0eef` supplies the inherited native chart and exact local rank-change setting.

SOURCES.json pins runtime copies at scientific ancestor `159eb73dd70ccdb03af6f61435135c026cf9886a`, with separate exact [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) source-provenance rows. A tree-preserving provenance merge retains [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) history for cold source checks. No predecessor package or selected frontier file changes. No public prospective CLAIM was posted before the short common-axis sweep finished; that finding is reported honestly as DONE. The later independent-pair experiment had a [prospective public CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867#issuecomment-6353171449) before its screen. Its producer files are retained byte-for-byte with exact origin hashes, two [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) transferred receipts and a scratch-only replay wrapper. The existing common-axis science is unchanged from published head `673b1f38379ee88513dfbe2d828845afa7c2f9ec`.

## Validation

On Ubuntu, Python 3.12, C++20 `g++`, with `-O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify_pairs.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify_pairs.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut --check-source-history
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut --ref b33e3d8670dc604d430e9cbeb86682f258acd52e --output /tmp/sol1337-global-centre-cut-review.tar
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/sol1337-global-centre-cut-review.tar
```

Expected direct output: `PASS_GLOBAL_CENTRE_CUT axes=262143 configurations=419 exact_prefix_cuts=3771 controls=3`. Registered ordinary and optimized commands, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, official 33-file committed export/integrity and Git-free original optimized plus pair normal replay with unchanged complete file hashes all pass locally. The source-history check includes canonical base, scientific 159eb73dd and exact [PR #4867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4867) head. Package-local attributes preserve authenticated predecessor CRLF bytes.

Every retained rank-energy configuration is independently checked by binary row elimination. Each cut checks conserved feasible flow, equal attaining cut capacity and a lifted original 184-variable rank-histogram invoice. Negative sign, nonidentity internal map and changed old invoice controls reject. A separate read-only agent found no correctness issue and independently priced180 literal mixed-group assignments over 36 axes and exhaustively compared 256 leaf assignments in 108 held-core/tariff cases. The parent separately read the proof and reran optimized warning-strict verification.

The new pair marker is `PASS_INDEPENDENT_ADJACENT_PAIRS opposite_cases=261632 profiles=44 rank0_edges=256 rank8_edges=8 graph_controls=3`. A separate read-only reviewer at exact final head `b33e3d8670dc604d430e9cbeb86682f258acd52e` found no correctness issue, checked all 33 source pins, reran the optimized pair verifier, independently priced 128 rank-eight pair invoices across all eight edges and checked 24 different-hyperplane geometry cases. Sixteen original scientific/input files remain byte-identical; only operational metadata, an appended README and new pair files were added. This is AI-agent review, not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

These finite computations certify the stated source-specific optimization; the written identity supplies the all-theta implication. [Hosted run 39871223220](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39871223220) passed at exact final head `b33e3d8670dc604d430e9cbeb86682f258acd52e`:346 helper tests with 11 expected skips, original normal/optimized common-axis checks, independent pair replay and committed-input mutation gate. This is registered automated replay, not independent mathematical acceptance.  independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed. No historical/native/Lean/Docker/selected-frontier suite was launched.

## Open next questions

The next primary construction question is now scoped in [Discussion #4902](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4902): two FULL native calls with different monomial-conjugate central functions on two arbitrary main banks. Its positive preliminary moment is unfunded and no controller is yet exhibited. Larger independent chart blocks or a genuinely changed source operation/demand would also require their own complete chronological boundary and optimistic paid bill. A profitable paid-profile candidate plus fully charged completion is required before native/compiler expansion. Another common-axis seed/subset or independent adjacent-pair scan cannot reopen these completed grammars. No further construction or κ claim is part of this PR.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The singleton-leaf topology reduced an apparently signed binary model to an exact cut. Complete rank-configuration deduplication made the full 262143-axis domain and all nine prefix tariffs finish in a few seconds, avoiding a large seed campaign. Registration required pinning local retained copies and predecessor provenance separately because the standard source-pin syntax preserves identical row/pin paths. The source-history merge makes that distinction cold-checkable.


## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated registered research package with a tree-preserving provenance merge. No predecessor files, production helper or selected record changes.
